0:
set -euo pipefail
cd typescript/server
export POSTGRES_URL="$${POSTGRES_URL}"
export SEEDS_DIR="../../db/seeds"
if [[ -z "$${SEEDS_COMMIT_HASH:-}" ]]; then
  SEEDS_COMMIT_HASH="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo local)"
fi
export SEEDS_COMMIT_HASH
bun run src/scripts/load-seeds-pg.ts

if [ ! -f /tmp/worker-heartbeat ]; then exit 1; fi
HEARTBEAT=$(cat /tmp/worker-heartbeat)
NOW=$(date +%s)
AGE=$((NOW - HEARTBEAT))
if [ $AGE -gt 60 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit 0

version: v1
flags:
  migStrategy: none
sharing:
  timeSlicing:
    renameByDefault: false
    failRequestsGreaterThanOne: false
    resources:
      - name: nvidia.com/gpu
        replicas: 5

exec > >(ts '%H:%M:%S') 2>&1
set -eu
restic backup --tag=db --stdin-from-command -- backup-cnpg.sh
restic forget --prune --keep-daily=90 --keep-weekly=24 --keep-monthly=24 --keep-yearly=20
restic cache --cleanup

[b2]
type = b2
hard_delete = false
[minio]
type = s3
provider = Minio
env_auth = true
endpoint = https://s3.mcswain.dev
[b2crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:mcswain-minio/astro
filename_encryption = standard
directory_name_encryption = true
